protocol.test_policy: one closed phase after source and checkpoint suite freeze
protocol.training: all first-six-day exposures; natural class ratio; Adam or declared candidate optimizer/loss; scratch initialization
protocol.static_snapshot_assumption: Publisher-provided user/ad snapshots treated as static benchmark attributes. Their as-of dates are undocumented; this is not verified production point-in-time data.

context.budget_scope: all preparation, calibration, research calls, failures, controls and final assessment count

knowledge_review.policy: Evaluate relevant external references against local evidence; adoption is optional. Missing source detail and negative transfer remain explicit.
knowledge_review.proposal_output: Add top-level knowledge_assessments: [{knowledge_id, decision: used|considered|rejected|unresolved, rationale, transformed_mechanism, variant_names, nearest_work_difference, falsifier}]. Cover retrieved industry cards; identify the concrete changed mechanism for used cards. This is provenance, not causal proof.
knowledge_review.reflection: Review the latest knowledge-usage.json alongside outcomes; distinguish declared use, executed changes, mechanism evidence and unresolved attribution.

assessments.rationale: Reviewed latest declared usage against negative fixed-head outcomes and read craft-paper-v1 lines 897-907. Source transport/rank observations do not identify the local loss failure. Prior arms executed no CRAFT component.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None. Calibration/dispersion follow-up comes from local receipts and algebra.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No contextual residual transport, context reliability gating, depth scaling or distillation. The local shallow reference inference is fixed; covariance/norm measurements are descriptive.
assessments.falsifier: An auxiliary loss or rank change alone cannot confirm CRAFT transfer; requires a separately registered transport control.

assessments.rationale: Current source card and unidot-paper-v1 lines 344-384 show task-specific next-action delay supervision and architecture coupling. Current labels do not supply that target; existing auxiliary experiments are not UniDot tests.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None from source. Centering uses only current training batch prevalence; no additional supervision.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No twin bus, FM highway, delay loss, new readout or optimizer. Mean/dispersion controls isolate local training signal behavior.
assessments.falsifier: A centered auxiliary gain cannot establish a highway or delay-supervision effect without their own admissible factorial.

assessments.rationale: Card remains organizer-summary only, with no authorized original implementation/full component ablations. No observed tokenization bottleneck follows from scalar head failure.
assessments.transformed_mechanism: None adopted; history and field tokens unchanged.
assessments.nearest_work_difference: No token allocation or gated sequence decoding; loss centering is not a tokenization experiment. Transfer and broad novelty remain unverified.
assessments.falsifier: Training-loss findings cannot adjudicate source token allocation; matched-capacity token replacement and source detail would be needed.

latest_knowledge_usage.limits: A declared source-to-code link is provenance, not a causal estimate of knowledge value or a novelty score.

context.final_assessment_scope: validation only; no test scores or predictions are supplied

reference_format: Use allowed_observation_ids verbatim for local evidence. Descriptive references are accepted when they contain a complete known ID. Correct any previous_runtime_error before submitting; its failed costs remain charged.
action: Read candidate.py and baseline_reference.py, diagnose an observed limitation, check primary nearest work, and implement a feasible candidate. Write proposal.json containing study (matching study_schema), parent_trial (existing trial ID), and variants (1-4 objects with distinct name, file basename ending .py, role candidate/control, config object, and note). At least one candidate is required. Add key ablations or matched controls for the claimed mechanism when feasible; reference existing matched trials as controls where justified. Each variant is a standalone module. Do not run training. New architecture choices come from evidence; industry cards do not mandate them.

candidate_api.Model: Model(meta, config) -> torch.nn.Module; forward(batch) -> finite [B] logits
optional: literal CONFIG dictionary for model dimensions/lr

Model.diagnostics(batch) -> at most 64 named finite scalars; host calls this on the first 512 validation impressions at the frozen best checkpoint, under no_grad. These are candidate-supplied measurements, requiring source-level scrutiny and controls.
candidate_api.ownership: Edit or create only candidate model modules and proposal.json. No filesystem/network access from model code. Numeric imports only: torch,numpy,math,typing,copy,functools,collections,itertools,dataclasses,contextlib.
candidate_api.local_checks: Torch is not installed in the coding jail. Perform syntax/source checks there; host training and scoring follow automatically. Do not install packages or wait for human review.
candidate_api.training: from scratch; fixed host epochs, data, sample coverage, supplied history, scorer and seeds; optional optimizer/loss changes require explicit attribution controls
